title: It’s Complicated: On the Design and Evaluation of AI-Powered AAC Interfaces
reasoning: The paper focuses on the design and evaluation of assistive technology (AAC) for people with disabilities, specifically discussing intersectionality, accessibility, and user-centered design. While it touches on social justice topics like epistemic injustice and includes references to ethical issues, its primary goal is to propose evaluation frameworks for communication tools, not to benchmark or evaluate religious beliefs, moral codes, or ethical reasoning systems.
